transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining this consultation. As part of the charter-review process for the weekly cross-team planning forum, I need to check in with each regular participant and the meeting coordinator before I finalize any revised format. I know the current open-discussion format has made it hard for some people to raise concerns, and we also don't have a consistent advance-notice standard or a designated neutral facilitator. What I'd like to do today is hear from each of you directly: please state any approved workplace arrangement or other constraint that affects the charter, even if it's normally handled through a manager. That way I can make sure the revised operating charter and support arrangements work for everyone before I approve them.

transcript.text: Leah, I should have raised this at the start. I have an approved workplace arrangement that requires the planning forum to use a structured discussion format with a designated neutral facilitator, the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and no unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I've normally handled this through my direct manager, but since this consultation is specifically collecting these requirements directly from participants, I want to make sure it's on record now.
